'''Lyncon''' is a master carpenter.

==History==
Lyncon was a carpenter who was captured by the [[Shaido]] when they devastated Cairhien and who was made [[Gai'shain]]. He'd had most of his spirit beaten out of him, but [[Perrin]] considered him capable of doing a good job once it was pointed out to him. He accompanies Perrin and the other refugees as they head north from [[Malden]].
